Home.heroTitle: Fancy Claude configs, minus the boring defaults.
Home.heroLede: A small collection of useful, stylish, and lightly ridiculous Claude configuration ideas. Starting with status bars and spinner copy.

statusbar.name: Good Statusbar
statusbar.summary: A compact Claude Code status line that shows repo context without turning the terminal into a dashboard.
statusbar.detail: Project, git branch, and local time. Small enough to stay out of the way.

spinner.name: Funny Spinner Verbs
spinner.summary: A small set of loading verbs for Claude-flavored tools that should feel playful without becoming childish.
spinner.detail: Use as a source list for custom UI states, status messages, or local wrappers.

corporateSpinner.name: Corporate Nonsense Spinner
corporateSpinner.summary: Chinese internet-business jargon for spinner verbs. Perfect for pretending the loading state is aligned with strategy.
corporateSpinner.detail: Replace boring loading copy with high-density business abstraction.

Home.belongsTitle: Configs should be useful, funny, or both.
Home.criteria4: Easy to copy, edit, and steal responsibly.
